content.text: The researcher has moved to company_owns_uni_academic_use and reduced review to 30 days. The IP model is acceptable - company owns results which is what we need. 30 days review is a reduction from our 60, but it's workable for a bounded contract research project where the key confidential element is our process data, not the underlying fouling science. I should accept this - it meets our core needs.
